_readme: Accepted risks for scripts/threat_intel.py. Add {"id": "GHSA-... or CVE-...", "package": "name as in the lockfile", "reason": "why it is not exploitable here, and the plan", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. An entry suppresses HIGH/CRITICAL/UNKNOWN findings until its expiry date (inclusive), then the gate fails again so someone decides anew. Keep expiries at 90 days or less. A CISA KEV match is never suppressed. Remove entries the brief reports as stale.
